cases.criterion: For each real initialized seat orientation, both unkept seats are eligible; frozen seat order selects its first seat, independent of the priority marker. The selected ActorInput binds that exact actor and supplied source/trial epoch.

After one seat actually TakesMulligan, the other seat is selected at its lesser mulligan count; after both take, the first seat is selected again. No action is repeated or inferred from the unchanged priority marker.
After one seat KeepsHand, the other unkept seat gets its opening choice before a pending BottomCards for the kept seat; after both keep, bottom choices route in frozen seat order.

On complete seven-card current own hands, the same two-through-five-Island predicate chooses KeepHand; outside that range it chooses a currently offered TakeMulligan, or the offered forced KeepHand if no mulligan remains.

The exact current cardsToBottom is selected from actor-visible current hand, using the declared surplus-land/duplicate/printed-cost/ID ordering; chosen IDs and action actor match the current offer; no future library identity is read.

After both seats have kept and completed any bottom choices, the router selects the actual first ordinary priority player (rather than the frozen first seat). At that actor's current main-phase observation, an offered basic Island or Snow-Covered Island is proposed only with a positive current land-drop count; the real PlayLand executes. No invented offer or stale input is accepted.
Wrong initialized seat, mismatched source/trial or prior epoch fails binding before any proposal; submitted policy RNG state remains the supplied independent stream.
Permuting unseen own-library order and opponent hidden hand identities leaves the complete sealed opening ActorInput and proposal invariant at equivalent current hand/resource/action offers.
